tasks.label: Flash F4 (j-link)
args: ((echo r & echo h & echo loadfile stm32f4-debug/${workspaceFolderBasename}.elf & echo q) > flash.jlink) && (JLink.exe -device STM32F407VG -if SWD -speed 4000 -NoGui 1 -CommandFile flash.jlink)

tasks.label: Flash F7 (j-link)
args: ((echo r & echo h & echo loadfile stm32f7-debug/${workspaceFolderBasename}.elf & echo q) > flash.jlink) && (JLink.exe -device STM32F746IG -if SWD -speed 4000 -NoGui 1 -CommandFile flash.jlink)
